release_build_evidence: Release configure and build completed before the campaign; the exact compiler, generator and executable SHA-256 values are in environment.json.
complete_merge_comparator_label: existing pair-materializing public baseline vs tiled public merge

reasons: Held b2=8, b1=18 fixed for every list size, so Q stayed at 2^10 while L grew: lambda = L^2/Q reached about 1024 against the declared TER paper scaling's 2-4.
At Q = 2^10 the tile policy gives tile_bits = min(15, 10) = 10, so S = Q, P = 1 bucket and 1 window. The tiled path degenerated to a single window and the comparison could not measure tiling at all.

Its memory columns were not comparable: src/merge.cpp gives the tiled path working_set_budget_bytes = fixed_bytes + a candidate ceiling absorbing the whole remaining budget, while the baseline reports a measured peak.
The L=2048 point returned ResourceLimit as a consequence of the first item.

frozen_artifact_note: Verified mechanically, not asserted: the frozen-artifact rows come from `git diff --quiet HEAD -- <path>`, the tile defaults are parsed out of include/ter/limitations.hpp, and the scope row compares `git diff --name-only HEAD` against the campaign allowlist.
failed_seed_policy: Every executed (L, seed) row is written to the raw CSV regardless of status or timing, and non-Completed rows are retained and flagged rather than dropped.
asymptotic_claim_note: Worst-case pair work remains O(|A||B|). Nothing in this campaign supports a subquadratic or exponent claim; the measured effects are finite-machine constant-factor and memory-footprint effects.
